pages.text: In expansive worlds, you may have multiple areas scattered across vast distances.$(br2)The problem$(br)The challenge is accessing your Refined Storage 2 system from all these locations. Running cables over long distances is impractical, especially if the area is 1000 blocks away.$(br2)The solution$(br)Utilize the $(l:transmitter)Network Transmitter$() and $(l:receiver)Network Receiver$() with improved signal strength and better reliability. First, craft a Network Transmitter and connect it to your main base's Refined Storage system. Then, craft a $(l:network_card)Network Card$() and a Network Receiver. Place the Network Receiver in the distant area. Right-click the Network Card on the Network Receiver to link them with enhanced security. Insert the Network Card into the Network Transmitter to establish the connection with improved stability.$(br2)Important considerations$(br)Ensure both the Controller in your main base and the Network Receiver in the remote area are chunkloaded before linking. After linking, maintain chunkloading for both areas to ensure continuous operation. RS2 features better cross-dimensional support and improved network stability.
